name: SDMA
summary: SDMA, also known as 3,4-methylenethiooxy-N-methylamphetamine (3T-MDMA) or as MY100, is a putative entactogen of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methylamphetamine (MDMA).

pharmacology.text: SDMA had similar activational efficacies at the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors as MDMA. Due to its greater potency as a monoamine releasing agent, SDMA may be active at lower doses or concentrations than MDMA. SDMA produced hyperlocomotion and hyperthermia in rodents with similar profiles as MDMA. However, SDMA did not produce rewarding effects in the conditioned place preference (CPP) paradigm unlike MDMA.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent; Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Entactogen; Stimulant

uses.en: It is a research compound with no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Entactogens of this family can cause jaw clenching, a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, dangerous overheating, low mood in the days after use, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這一類同感藥可能引起咬牙、心跳加快、血壓升高、危險的體溫過高、使用後幾天情緒低落，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这一类同感药可能引起咬牙、心跳加快、血压升高、危险的体温过高、使用后几天情绪低落，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: SDMA is MDMA with the two ring oxygens replaced by sulfur atoms. It was one of a set made to test whether such swaps could keep MDMA's effects while changing its risks.
fact.zh: SDMA 是把 MDMA 環上的兩個氧原子換成硫原子。它是一組為了測試這種替換能否保留 MDMA 效果、同時改變風險而合成的化合物之一。
fact.zhHans: SDMA 是把 MDMA 环上的两个氧原子换成硫原子。它是一组为了测试这种替换能否保留 MDMA 效果、同时改变风险而合成的化合物之一。
